spans.s:
AIR (v. t.):
I To admit the fresh air: सुप्र-
वातः (ता, तं) करोति।
II To dry: q. v. आतपे
 ददाति (दा, c. 3) (to expose to the sun).

AIRING:
I A walk or ride in the air: वायु-
सेवनं
or
वायुपरिसेवनं।
II An exposure to air:
v. To air.

AIRY (adj.):
I Consisting of air.
(1) वायवः
(वी, वं);
(2) वायुमयः (यी, यं).
II Relating
to air: Ph.
took an a. flight
वियदुत्पपात, N. or
विहायसा जगाम;
the a. regions
वायुवर्त्मन्, प्रवहमार्गः।
III Open to air: सुवातः (ता, तं).
IV
Vain, trifling:
(1) शून्यः (न्या, न्यं);
(2)
असारः (रा, रं). V. Gay, lively: q. v.
